name: list_entries
description: List baby log entries, newest first. Omit kind to list all kinds, grouped by kind. Returns at most `limit` entries per kind and says when results are truncated.

kind.description: Which entries to list: diapers, breastfeeding, bottles, spit_ups or weights. Omit to list every kind, grouped by kind.

since.description: Only entries at or after this time. ISO 8601 with or without an offset, e.g. '2026-01-12T08:30:00+02:00' or '2026-01-12T08:30:00' (the latter is in the configured timezone).

until.description: Only entries strictly before this time. Same ISO 8601 formats as since.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return per kind (default 20, maximum 200).
